import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the theme for the plot
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot for price vs. megapixels colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', markers={0: 'o', 1: 'X'}, palette='deep', alpha=0.7)

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Price vs. Megapixels of Digital Cameras', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type & 4K Video Capability', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
